text: Every client conversation creates work. Notes to write up, records to update, follow-ups to send. Fifteen hours a week of it.
Write the note you'd write anyway. It picks out what matters: the budget, the dial, the material. Accept it, and her profile's up to date.
It finds the right piece in stock.
And drafts a personal follow-up. Check it, send it, and it's on her record for whoever she speaks to next.
Fifteen hours a week back, and every follow-up out in under five minutes.
